# Third-party files in this folder

Loaded only by Pro > Pitch decks, and only when they're needed.

- `pptxgen.bundle.js`: PptxGenJS 4.0.1 (includes JSZip). MIT licence. https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
- `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs`: PDF.js 6.2.108 (Mozilla). Apache 2.0 licence. https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
